title: cephaelis hastisepala
intro: Cephaelis hastisepala, commonly known as the Jamaican dogwood, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia by promoting relaxation and calming the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Cephaelis hastisepala include its analgesic, sedative, and anti-anxiety properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as scopoletin and scopoletin glucoside. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
